name: People In Love And Not Married
overview: Scripture reveals that God created marriage as a divine provision for companionship, declaring it not good for man to be alone and instituting the union of husband and wife as one flesh (Genesis 2:18, 24). The blessings of marriage are affirmed in Proverbs, highlighting the value and favor found in a virtuous wife (Proverbs 18:22, 31:10). Furthermore, Isaiah portrays marriage as a joyful covenant reflecting God's rejoicing over His people, underscoring the sacredness and joy inherent in the marital relationship (Isaiah 62:5). These passages collectively affirm that love is to be expressed within the covenant of marriage as God designed it.
